values.note: RV parking (lots 1-13) $25 a night, showers included for registered campers (Welcome Center shower $5 a person otherwise). Register in the Welcome Center on arrival; fees on the honor system, paid before departure. Stays of 7 days or longer: contact the park office for payment instructions. Read 2026-11-12.

note: Bottineau Park District RV park in Tommy Turtle Park, home of the giant 'Tommy Turtle' statue (1001 10th St E); lots 1-13 are 7 large pull-through and 6 back-in sites. New Welcome Center with restrooms and showers; picnic shelters, tennis and pickleball courts, ball diamonds, playgrounds. --Claude
